textbookBox.concept: Look around you. Which things or people make you laugh? In this poem by Natalie Joan, a very strange man walks down the street, and everything he does is upside down.

beats.en: Look around you. Which things or people make you laugh? In this poem by Natalie Joan, a very strange man walks down the street, and everything he does is upside down. Let us see how nonsense can be great fun.
beats.speakEn: Look around you. Which things or people make you laugh? In this poem by Natalie Joan, a very strange man walks down the street, and everything he does is upside down. Let us see how nonsense can be great fun.

beats.en: You look around for things or people that make you laugh, write them in bubbles and share your reasons with your classmates and teacher.
beats.speakEn: You look around for things or people that make you laugh, write them in bubbles and share your reasons with your classmates and teacher.

beats.en: One day a funny man comes walking down the street. He wears a shoe on his head and hats on his feet. He raises the shoe to the poet and smiles, and he is polite, but the poet has never seen such a funny sounding sight.
beats.speakEn: One day a funny man comes walking down the street. He wears a shoe on his head and hats on his feet. He raises the shoe to the poet and smiles, and he is polite, but the poet has never seen such a funny sounding sight.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 english · A Funny Man · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: In the true or false exercise, these are true: the poet says she had never heard such an amusing song, the funny man wore two hats on his feet, he hopped home on his head, and he smiled at the poet.

beats.en: In the true or false exercise, these are true: the poet says she had never heard such an amusing song, the funny man wore two hats on his feet, he hopped home on his head, and he smiled at the poet.
beats.speakEn: In the true or false exercise, these are true: the poet says she had never heard such an amusing song, the funny man wore two hats on his feet, he hopped home on his head, and he smiled at the poet.

beats.en: The poet mixes up the senses on purpose. A sound that you can see, a smell that looks and a sound that you feel are nonsense phrases, which is what makes the poem funny.

textbookBox.concept: What appeals to you about the funny man? Perhaps his politeness, his cheerfulness or his imagination. His unusual actions make the mood light and silly.
